direction.camera: Guide attention with openworld vista; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: use foreground and distant horizon to establish explorable scale; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with atmospheric layers; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with inviting depth.
direction.lighting: wide dawn glow; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: grassland haze and weathered rock; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around scale contrast; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use openworld vista,atmospheric layers,dawn horizon,slow reveal,scale contrast,inviting depth as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
